items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Things that he did in the band would shame the boys and after he was with us about a year he was just as nice and calm

ctx.x: us a story. He said the girls were dressing in the dormitory and he was peeping through the window and fell through the window. He had a cut on his arm. But he was a terrific tenor man and Ben Webster was really my first love. We used to be together all the time. I loved him. Things that he did in the band would shame the boys and after he was with us about a year he was just as nice and calm, because the guys were so nice in the band and they always helped wild musicians like Ben and he was really a wild one.
But he was your first love and nothing ever came of it?
